crate-1x1x3.title: Crate 1x1x3
crate-1x1x3.blurb: Stackable crate, usable cavity 38x38x16 mm. Divider slots every 21 mm, front label recess, clip sockets on the sides.
crate-1x1x3.print_notes: Upright, no supports, 3 walls, 15% infill. Optional 6x2 mm magnets.
